BOUNDLESS.Title: Boundless, Seamless World
BOUNDLESS.StatusLoaded: Seamless GPU renderer and spatial chunk streamer active.

Config.EnabledHint: Enables the Quadtree pyramid, GPU lighting batch, and spatial world streaming.
Config.LevelEnabledHint: Attaches a dedicated manifest or baked virtual tiles, walls, lights, and sounds to this level.
Config.ManifestUrlHint: URL to the pyramid and sector JSON manifest (defaults to the built-in 1000×1000 map).
Config.PyramidBaseUrlHint: Optional. Leave blank if this level only uses streamed tiles without a background pyramid.
Config.MaxLosPxHint: Caps token line-of-sight raycast radius (default 4500 px = 225 ft).
Config.ChunkedFogHint: High-resolution 50×50-cell chunked exploration memory bypassing Foundry's 4096 px limit. Follows the scene's native fog mode (Disabled, Individual, Shared) from the Visibility tab.
Config.ShowPoisHint: Displays categorized clickable location pins with automatic anti-overlap decluttering on macro zoom-out.
Config.ShowCharacterPinsHint: Displays your assigned character's portrait on the map when zoomed out and a sticky edge pointer when off-screen for one-click close focus.
Config.VirtualizeTokensHint: Draws native non-player token placeables strictly inside each client's viewport with a per-frame budget and LRU-unmounts distant PIXI objects without modifying scene documents.
Config.PoiJournalNoAccess: You do not have permission to view this journal.
Config.ResetFogDone: Chunked Fog of War cleared for the current level.
Config.BakeConfirmBody: Bake tiles, walls, lights, and ambient sounds on level "{level}" into Boundless spatial streaming?
Config.BakeRemoveOriginals: Remove original documents from the scene after baking
Config.BakeDone: Level "{level}" baked: {tiles} tiles, {walls} walls, {lights} lights, {sounds} sounds.

BOUNDLESS.PoiToolHint: Pin Mode: Left-click map to create, drag pin to move, Right-click for menu, Esc to exit.
BOUNDLESS.FogBrushHint: Fog Brush: Left-click to reveal, Shift + Left-click to hide, Alt + Wheel to resize, Esc to exit.

Optimize.DialogBody: Scene "{scene}" will be automatically optimized for fast loading and smooth performance at any zoom level.
Optimize.CreateCopy: Create an optimized copy of the scene
Optimize.CreateCopyHint: Keeps the original scene untouched and opens the optimized copy automatically once finished.
